If you have a daughter, tell her these 12 things. ❤️📝

One day the world will cover her mirror in notes: too much, not enough, be quiet, be cool, be more like her. So make sure she hears it from you first. 🌍

When Ella was six, her mom stuck twelve yellow notes on her mirror, one at a time:
✨ You are loved, even on your worst day.
✨ It's okay to say no.
✨ Be kind, not a doormat.
✨ Never shrink to be loved.
✨ Speak up, even if your voice shakes.
✨ Walk away from disrespect.
✨ Choose friends who choose you.
✨ Don't compare your story.
✨ You can always come home.
✨ I will always believe in you.

At thirteen, the world started adding notes of its own. "Just say yes." One hard night, she cried in front of that mirror… and her mom's words were still there. They were the first words she heard. 🥹

And they were never just Mom's words. They were God's. "Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name, you are mine." Isaiah 43:1 (ESV) 🙏

Jesus paid for her. Nothing the world writes can change whose she is. ❤️ Years later, Ella sticks the first yellow note on her own daughter's mirror.
